title: gamochaeta coarctata
intro: Gamochaeta coarctata, commonly known as Argentine chamomile, is a flowering plant species in the daisy family. It is used as a herbal remedy due to its health benefits, which include treating anxiety and insomnia, as well as its anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Argentine chamomile include its sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-spasmodic effects, which make it useful for soothing digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Gamochaeta coarctata include flavonoids, terpenoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
